title: twas-xcal: ancestry-aware null calibration for transcriptome-wide association studies
description: twas-xcal provides XCAL and XCAL-t, ancestry-aware null calibration for TWAS tests (PrediXcan, S-PrediXcan, FUSION-type statistics) under polygenic architectures. The polygenic inflation slope of TWAS statistics is ancestry-specific: European-derived variance-control corrections are miscalibrated when transferred to East Asian, African, South Asian or admixed American GWAS. XCAL uses an ancestry-matched LD panel and a finite-sample-unbiased quadratic estimator; XCAL-t adds a delete-block jackknife Satterthwaite t-reference that absorbs LD-panel noise. The release includes a reproducible multi-ancestry TWAS null simulator (msprime/stdpopsim), validation on 3,538 simulated gene models, and real-data validation on 12,453 MESA expression models across 2,490 1000 Genomes genomes from five ancestries.
